blindness_caveat: A general web search for 'Ford Motor Company mergers acquisitions history recent' returned an M&A summary aggregator (Mergr) and a 10-K XBRL fact table (Financial_Report.xlsx) alongside independent sources (TechCrunch, electrek, Ford press releases). The events below are dated/scoped from TechCrunch, electrek, and Ford's own press release only; no 8-K or 10-K prose was seen before this file was written, though a 10-K sentence for Electriphi ('...On June 18, 2021, we acquired Electriphi...') was seen afterward, during diagnostic testing of the extraction pattern -- not used to write this gold record.
note: Third company in a row (after Brinker) picked deliberately as a low-M&A-frequency company, to test the true-negative/structural-coverage-gap case rather than another headline merger. Ford's recent real acquisitions (Electriphi 2021, AMP/Auto Motive Power 2023) are both small, non-material, terms-undisclosed acqui-hires of private startups -- neither got a substantive standalone 8-K. Electriphi IS disclosed in real, clean, parseable prose, but only in the 10-K's 'Acquisitions and Divestitures' footnote ('On June 18, 2021, we acquired Electriphi...'), which needs the still-nonexistent 10-K fetcher to ever reach. AMP has no equivalent structured disclosure found at all (deal too recent/small relative to Ford's size; the closest-dated 8-K uses Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure pointing generically at a news-release exhibit with no entity-naming text in the item body itself). Scoped to these two only; Ford's much larger historical acquisitions (Volvo Car 1999, Land Rover 2000) predate practical full-text EDGAR body coverage, same rationale as every other gold file's pre-2015-ish cutoff.
